hero_content.eyebrow: HOSPITAL-BASED COSMETIC SURGERY · HO CHI MINH CITY
hero_content.title: Plastic Surgery in Vietnam for International Patients
hero_content.description: Cosmetic surgery is a medical decision before it is an aesthetic one. At DR. MARIS AESTHETICS, your case is personally assessed and managed by Dr. Maris, with surgery performed at City International Hospital (CIH) in Ho Chi Minh City.
hero_content.secondary_description: From primary cosmetic procedures to complex revision surgery, every surgical plan begins with your anatomy, medical history, previous procedures and individual goals.

surgical_care_process.title: Who will actually perform my surgery?
surgical_care_process.description: Dr. Maris brings 6+ years of specialized cosmetic surgery experience to every case. Unlike high-volume clinics, we strictly limit our surgical schedule so that Dr. Maris is personally involved in every critical step of your journey.

revision_surgery.title: Revision Cosmetic Surgery Vietnam
revision_surgery.subtitle: When Your First Surgery Did Not Go as Planned
revision_surgery.description: Revision surgery is not simply doing the procedure again. It requires a careful assessment of what was performed, the tissue that remains and what can be safely improved.

doctor_assessment.title: Your Case Is Personally Assessed by Dr. Maris
doctor_assessment.description: A thorough assessment considers anatomy, previous procedures, implant history, surgical goals, limitations and recovery expectations before any recommendation is made.

hospital_based_surgery.title: Surgery Performed at City International Hospital (CIH)
hospital_based_surgery.description: Hospital-based surgery provides the medical infrastructure, safety systems and specialist support required for complex aesthetic procedures.

international_patients.title: Planning Plastic Surgery in Vietnam From Overseas
international_patients.description: A seamless, medically-supervised experience from your first inquiry to your final recovery.

consultation.title: Begin Your Journey
consultation.description: We do not offer generic tourism packages. We provide individualized medical assessments to determine the safest and most effective approach for your goals.

frequently_asked_questions.question: Is DR. MARIS AESTHETICS a spa or cosmetic surgery provider?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: We are a specialized cosmetic surgery provider. All surgical procedures are performed in a fully accredited international hospital with comprehensive medical infrastructure.

frequently_asked_questions.question: Who performs my cosmetic surgery?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: Every surgery is personally performed by Dr. Maris. Your care is managed directly by the lead surgeon from planning through follow-up.

frequently_asked_questions.question: Can I speak with Dr. Maris before travelling to Vietnam?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: Yes. We require an online video consultation to review your medical history, photographs, and surgical goals before travel arrangements are finalized.

frequently_asked_questions.question: Does Dr. Maris perform revision plastic surgery?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: Dr. Maris specializes in complex revision cases, including corrective rhinoplasty, breast implant revision, and scar management.

frequently_asked_questions.question: Can failed cosmetic surgery always be corrected?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: Many issues can be improved, but correction depends on the healthy tissue remaining and the nature of the previous surgery.

frequently_asked_questions.question: How long should I stay in Vietnam after plastic surgery?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: Stay duration varies by procedure, typically ranging from 7 to 14 days to allow initial follow-up examinations before flying.

frequently_asked_questions.question: How much does plastic surgery cost in Vietnam?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: Quotes are provided after clinical assessment. We prioritize safety and hospital-based care over budget pricing.

frequently_asked_questions.question: What should I send if I need revision surgery?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: Please provide previous operative reports, the date of your last surgery, high-resolution photos, and a description of your concerns.
